text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
Phew... whew...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh...!! NORTH FLIIIIIIIGHT!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel completely in sync. I can fly as far as I want...!
A mile race really is—my kind of race!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll win—by staying true to myself!!
Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flight dashed past the finish line in first place—
that brilliant light burned itself into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
North Flight! It's North Flight!!
What incredible strength...!
This is the power of Japan's sprint Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That settles it!
The mile—is Flight's stage!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... hehe!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I really like
who I am right now...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Extremely!
It's shining so brightly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I...!
—I proved that this was the best coord!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart is still pounding.
Watching North Flight's magnificent radiance... I was dreaming a great, big dream.
choice_data_list: (She still has so much room to grow...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If she keeps running like this, she will surely become a legend. A brilliant chapter shining in the history of mile racing――"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Graaaace!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Both Flight and Bakushin O!
Exciiiiting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Especially... Flight!
You are the Big Wall, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I am getting excited!
――Next is my time!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
At my own speed!
I'll overtake both of them, yes I wiiill~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Mega bad.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"This is sooo bad, Miss Ojo~~!!
Can we, like, do the Yasuda again~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—They totally stole the Best Live spot from us?!
Frappe and Baku-chan did?!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fans
text_block_list.text:
Flight-saaannn!
Beat Bakushin O-san next time too!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin Fans
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O!!
Win it next time, pleaseee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What's next...!?
What will be their next clash...?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It seems our battle is far from over.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phewwww...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm so frustrated!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You really are fascinating!
So fast! ...Right now, faster even than me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Howeeeever!
The one leading the pack must always be me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is revenge!
This time, I will strip away your pride!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, where to next?!
Where shall our speeds clash next!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Your best outfit: 1200m...
And my best outfit: 1600m.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since what suits me best is so clear,
I might not be able to choose between the two... right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, indeed...!
Then, outside of short distance—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No. There is still a coord
that we haven't worn yet.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A proposal.
—How about a 1400m race?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to know?
Which of us can truly master this speed—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Doesn't it make you excited? We can become so much more stylish...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Splendiddd!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A mere 200m is over in an instant with my speed!
Which means... it suits me the best!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
I'm sure it would suit you as well, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With 200m cut from the hem...
I believe I will be the faster one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
!
...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well, 1400m... Challenge accepted!
It's a new Bakushin showdown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So—which race will it be!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, hearing the whole story from both of them,
I agreed to their next showdown being at 1400m.
Then, they asked for my advice on choosing a race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Swan Stakes is a 1400m GII race.
Taking place in October, it would be the perfect stage for a showdown between the two after a fulfilling summer."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all!
How about you, Bakushin O-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
S, w, a, n, S, t, a, k, e, s...
Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly 1400 meters!
That gets a big fat circle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll guide them through the 1,400m race without fail and on to the next GⅠ!
After all, there are still races where I must set a stellar example!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...I see, that's right.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll just have to make sure
you never overtake me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaah!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll definitely overtake them!
Especially with summer training camp coming up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall return having achieved another Bakushin evolution!
See you at the Swan Stakes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, huh...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Let's give your outfit an update!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race...
was decided to be the Swan Stakes.
